maria: heads-up — after yesterday's kernel-selector change i'm seeing a tail-latency bump on chat.stream (p95->p99). small but customer-visible. hist: https://perf.redwood/exp/abc123
maria: payloads are normal size (~120 tokens), but token-level breakdown shows an extra 2-6ms in a compute-ish bucket for the slow ones
maria: snippet from traces (trimmed):
```
route=chat.stream model=rwkv-7b kernel=auto-v2 seq=128 queue_ms=1 compute_ms=18 serialize_ms=2 validate_ms=0 retry_ms=0
route=chat.stream model=rwkv-7b kernel=jit-match seq=128 queue_ms=1 compute_ms=24 serialize_ms=2 validate_ms=0 retry_ms=1
```
tao: interesting — jit-match kernel increases compute_ms + retry in that row. could be fallback path triggering memcpy or kernel recompile?
alex: also check kv cache hits — if prefix cache misses we do extra memory ops that show up as compute. did we change prefetch windows in the selector?
maria: we did reduce the batch-aware prefetch window for the new heuristic. i thought that would reduce wasted memory churn, not increase it.
nisha: related: tool/function validation now runs synchronously for structured outputs on the hot path for a subset of routes. if validation fails we retry with a stricter parser which adds retry_ms. might be correlated.
jeff: we need token-level instrumentation that separates: queue_ms | compute_ms | memcpy_ms | validate_ms | retry_ms. current compute_ms is too aggregated.
perf-bot: new profile uploaded: s3://profiles/1802501234/jit-match-pprof.pb.gz (flamegraph + memstats)
infra-bot: deploy-log: kernel-selector v2 rolled at 2026-03-15T21:03:12Z onto pool-gamma. canary 20%. no deploy failures recorded.
ta o: i'll pull the pprof and look for memcpy hotspots. initial guess: kernel choice triggers a codepath that uses cpu fallback for certain ops (int8->fp32 conversions?)
alex: i'll add KV cache hit/miss tags to the trace spans and a quick dashboard panel (per-route kv_hit_rate, avg_cache_latency). want to see if slow requests have miss spikes.
nisha: i'll audit the structured-output validator: can we offload initial fast-syntax-check to async path and only do full validation on serialize step? reduces validate_ms on token path.
jeff: for dashboards — add per-route token-level percentiles (p50/p90/p95/p99) and stacked breakdown by those ms buckets. also add a chart for retries per 1k tokens.
maria: agree. also plan: rollback selector v2 in canary if p99 increases > 5ms for chat.stream for 15m. set an automated test that compares ticketed routes.
sre-oncall: i'll add alerts: rule=route_p99 > baseline+5ms for 10m AND kv_miss_rate > baseline+2% -> paging. keep thresholds conservative.
perf-bot: scheduled perf diff job: compare kernel-selector-v1 -> v2 on historical workload (7200s) — results ETA 30m.
maria: small ops: (1) tao analyze pprof (2) alex add kv tags + dashboard panel (3) nisha prototype async validate (4) jeff add token-bucketed panels + retry counter (5) me create canary rollback runbook. ping here with links when ready. :thumbsup:
